subject.title: [Feature]: Option to force-prepend an opening <think> tag for local reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class default-off synthetic `<think>` opener option, or should model-specific delimiter behavior stay provider-owned through params and catalog metadata?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but repository policy treats new config/default and provider/output-format behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and existing provider thinking controls are adjacent but not equivalent.

options.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer confirmation that provider params/catalog metadata cannot cover the named models before adding a core delimiter setting.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core option
options.body: Approve one documented default-off config path, with global/per-model precedence and streaming plus final-message proof.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject frontend-side delimiter synthesis and ask users to rely on provider/model prompt or request settings instead.

recommendation.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer confirmation that provider params/catalog metadata cannot cover the named models before adding a core delimiter setting.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior maintainer review framing and owns the adjacent reasoning-tag parser fix that defines the current boundary.
